metadata.analyst_addendum_2026_07_02_v2: Second client directive relayed 2026-07-02: the 'australia' national qualifier on the 4 new-product keywords is WRONG per the client's location instruction -- they said 'focus Sydney & Melbourne ... main focus Melbourne', which rules out national-qualified primaries entirely, not just QLD expansion. Swapped: 'smart toilet australia'->'smart toilet melbourne' (880->50/mo), 'bidet toilet australia'->'bidet toilet melbourne' (390->40/mo, KD jumps 1->42 because the Melbourne SERP mixes in 2 local installer/plumber local-pack results not present on the bare-Australia SERP), 'outdoor tv australia'->'outdoor tv melbourne' (880->0/mo measured -- FLAGGED, no national or state keyword-planner tool shows ANY measurable monthly volume for this exact phrase; SERP is still winnable/retailer-dominated (outdoortv.com.au, Sylvox, Harvey Norman) but the keyword itself won't register in rank-tracking volume reports -- kept per client instruction but analyst should confirm with client this is acceptable given effective_keyword_reach drops materially), 'bbq pod australia'-> 'bbq pods melbourne' (390->30/mo, switched to plural because singular 'bbq pod melbourne' has 0 measured volume while plural has real volume -- Instagram/Future Shade's own social presence uses 'BBQPODSMELB' handle, confirming plural is the natural local phrasing). Net effect: combined primary volume for these 4 slots drops from 2,150/mo (australia-qualified) to 120/mo (melbourne-qualified) -- a genuine data trade-off from strict geo-consistency, flagged for the analyst/client, not silently absorbed.
